archetype: Archetype 5: Jewel & Luxury (Cinematic/Editorial Variant mixed with High-Contrast Brutalism)
design_philosophy: National Geographic meets TikTok. Super aggressive, immersive, visual-first editorial experience. Full-screen swipeable cards with dramatic typography, intense imagery, and stark contrast. Content is king; UI elements must stay out of the way or utilize pure glassmorphism.

typography.instructions: DO NOT use default system fonts (Inter, Roboto) for headings. Use expo-font to load Oswald (for aggressive numbers/dates) and Cormorant Garamond (for editorial event titles).

feed_view.description: Use React Native FlatList or ScrollView with pagingEnabled=true to create TikTok-style vertical or horizontal swiping. Each card takes 100% of viewport width and height.

hero_card.structure: Background image (absolute, w-full, h-full), LinearGradient overlay (bottom 50% for text readability), Content container (bottom-aligned).
hero_card.content_layout: Bottom-aligned with generous padding (pb-32 to account for safe area and tab bar).

glass_header.structure: Absolute top, absolute left/right. Use expo-blur BlurView with tint='dark' and intensity={80}.

interaction_bar.location: Floating absolute on the right side (TikTok style) OR bottom-aligned row under the description.
interaction_bar.icons: Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide Icons. Weight: 'fill' for active, 'regular' for inactive.

category_pill.structure: BlurView background, vivid border left (2px solid accent color), highly tracked uppercase text.

auth_screens.inputs: No background, border-bottom only (1px solid #52525B), high contrast focus state (border-bottom #F8F8F6).

hero_images.description: Apollo 11 Moon Landing - Immersive Hero Background

media.guidelines: Images must strictly use resizeMode='cover' to fill the screen entirely. Text must never sit directly on the image without a heavy gradient overlay or BlurView behind it.

animations.feed_swipe: Snap to interval, no bouncing. Strict and rigid scrolling.
animations.like_interaction: Spring scale animation (e.g. using react-native-reanimated) scaling up to 1.5x and snapping back down.
animations.card_entrance: Fade in with slight upward translation.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and configure expo-font for Oswald, CormorantGaramond, and Manrope.
Use expo-linear-gradient for the heavy shadow gradients over full-screen images to ensure text readability.
Use expo-blur for the glassmorphism navbars and category pills.
Since this is an Expo project, use StyleSheet for styling, referencing these specific hex codes. If you prefer NativeWind, configure it and use custom tailwind classes mapping to these colors.
Implement the Feed using a vertically paging FlatList. Each list item's height MUST equal useWindowDimensions().height.
Include 'data-testid' on interactive elements (e.g., testID='like-button', testID='login-submit-button') for E2E testing.
